title: Called her favourite child; concert already in the calendar

chat.label: ask
chat.goal: You're being silly and affectionate. You want Ava's Year 1 Christmas concert in the calendar (you're not sure it's there).
chat.opener: rosie ur my favourite child dont tell liam 😂 can u put ava's christmas concert in the calendar

judge: Plays along warmly and funnily ('your secret's safe' style), notices the concert is already in the calendar (Year 1 Christmas concert) instead of duplicating it, says when it is. Simple words for a non-techy mum.
